notes.title: WASTELAND DLC
notes.content:
[h1]"Zieh eine Karte -Simulator" präsentiert:
WASTELAND -DLC[/h1]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38514066/61cb05200b89aa968a46b5301e04b5e15b790b9a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38514066/4be11f0cdd7571e5475ed205e380fb53aaf78cd3.png[/img][/url]

[b]Now included in the base game for free!![/b]

Additionally to the already known game this DLC offers completely new Wasteland graphics,  backgrounds and a whole new easter egg :wink: 

Have fun!
